name: better-crawler-4-agent
description: Turn URLs into clean article text with a real browser. Handles JS-heavy and anti-bot sites (Zhihu, CSDN, Juejin) that plain HTTP fetchers miss. URL discovery is left to the caller.

description_i18n.en: URL to article text via a real stealth browser. Reliable on JS-heavy and anti-bot sites.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 用真实浏览器把 URL 变成干净正文，对 JS 站点与知乎/CSDN 等反爬站点有效。
